concerns.text: Task T037 (Regression) is listed before T039 (VIF) and T043 (PCA). The spec (Section 3.4) and plan (Complexity Tracking) mandate VIF and PCA to handle collinearity and coupled variables BEFORE regression. T037 consumes data that T039/T043 must validate/transform. Re-order: T039, T043 -> T037.

Task T045 (Integrate defect density) is listed after T037 (Regression). T045 explicitly depends on T033 (Phase 4) and must precede T037 to ensure the regression model includes the mandated predictor. Current order implies regression runs without the required variable.

Task T033 (Defect density quantification) is marked incomplete and appears after T024/T025 (DFT). While T033 is a calculation task, the spec (Section 3.3) requires this metric as a primary predictor for the regression in Phase 5. Ensure T033 is completed and logically positioned before Phase 5 regression tasks.

Task T044 (Define JSON schema) is listed after T045b (Store results). Schema definition (T044) must precede data storage (T045b) to ensure the output format is defined before writing. Re-order: T044 -> T045b.
Task T046 (Validation) is listed after T037 (Regression). T046 explicitly states it 'MUST precede T037' to reject invalid data points. The current list order contradicts this explicit dependency.
